page.overview:
Who is Kofu?

Kofu is a character appearing in Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet. He is the Gym Leader at Cascarrafa's Gym and is one of the eight Gym Leaders in which the player can fight in any order they chose. He specializes in types.

Kofu is a middle-aged man with black eyes, white and blue unibrow and goatee. He wears a white shirt and pants with matching shoes and a blue apron with six pockets.

Kofu is a cook who is popular among his people for the innovative dishes he creates at his restaurant, often sourcing high-quality and/or rare ingredients for his dishes from Porto Marinada. However, he is occasionally careless and tends to forgets something when in a rush. He often uses the term "Vaultin' Veluza!" to express surprise or shock.

He is also a proficient Gym Leader and places confidence in his Water-type Pokémon to overwhelm his opponents.
